technique_name: Explain how artificial intelligence can be used for medical and healthcare purposes.
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) can be used in medical and healthcare in a variety of ways. AI can be used to diagnose diseases, recommend treatments, provide personalized medicine, optimize clinical pathways, match individual patient and prescription data, streamline hospital operations, detect fraud, and reduce costs.
